texts: The Council doubled the feather ration of the Stilllight Station twenty-six years ago.
Sixty-three years ago, Old Vesh's father walked the Cove Stair every evening with three Keepers.

fields.sentence: The Council doubled the feather ration of the Stilllight Station twenty-six years ago.

review.notes: "the Council" correctly stays a capitalized-common-noun witness with no Name; "Stilllight Station" is one opaque name symbol with the in-name kind word as an ordinary type atom, and "twenty-six years ago" takes the BeforeBy/now anchor as specified.

fields.sentence: Sixty-three years ago, Old Vesh's father walked the Cove Stair every evening with three Keepers.

q2_gaps: a past-tense habitual/iterative clause ("walked the Cove Stair every evening"): the frequency section says the event stays unmarked ("no Past/Ongoing - habitual") while the tense rule marks every finite past clause with (Past e), and the instruction set never says which governs a past habitual

distribution of a counted comitative group ("with three Keepers") to its members: the per-member (PartOf $x <group>) rule is specified for a group that is the clause's subject / predicated participant, not for a CoAgent filler, so whether each Keeper's own walking is derivable is unaddressed
review.notes: The name/kind split for "Old Vesh" and "the Cove Stair", the kinship genitive as Possession, the every-evening slot plus implied 1-day cycle, and the BeforeBy-now anchor for "sixty-three years ago" all follow the instruction set as written.
